# Gruvaktien handelsstoppad efter fängelsedom: "Otroliga arvoden"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-10-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This episode covers the scandal around Eurobattery Minerals, the NGM-listed owner of the Finnish mining company Finn Cobalt. Its CEO Roberto Garcia has been convicted of aggravated fraud in Spain and is suspected of aggravated insider trading in Sweden, and the stock has been suspended from trading since mid-September. The EU Commission has opened an inquiry into the CRMA strategic-project status it gave the Finnish mine. The board has been hollowed out, with no chair, no auditors and no Swedish members, so the tone is clearly negative and cautionary.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ BAT — Eurobattery Minerals | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Trading halted; CEO convicted of fraud, suspected of insider trading; no board chair, auditors, or Swedish directors; EU reviewing CRMA status.

#### Reasoning

The reporter describes a company built on hope, with no revenue, while the CEO sold shares and took very large fees through private foreign companies. The CEO's two-year fraud sentence was upheld by Spain's Supreme Court, and he was not disclosed to the market. Governance has collapsed: the board has no chair and no Swedish members, and the auditors have resigned. NGM may weigh whether to delist the stock. The EU may withdraw the CRMA status, which would remove permitting and funding benefits. T

#### Sell Triggers

- if a credible new board, chair and auditors are appointed and the CEO is fully removed
- if the EU confirms the CRMA status after its review
- if Finland grants the mining permit

> *"Det finns inga svenska medborgare i den här styrelsen längre, efter avhopp den senaste tiden. Det finns inte heller några revisorer. De har också hoppat av och det finns inte en styrelseordförande."*
